fields.Name: T156 - Algorithm Catalog Guide-Me
fields.Description: Exercises the use-case ranking matrix drive: scenario-chip selection re-sorting cards by RecommendationLevel and rendering the guide banner — a distinct data-driven interaction, robust because the algorithm catalog is seeded fixed metadata.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door and select the 'Algorithm Catalog' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Verify the algorithm card gallery renders (cards like XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest, Logistic Regression with problem-type tags). Then, in the 'Guide me' scenario picker, click one or more scenario chips. Success is the catalog RESPONDING: a recommendation banner appears naming top-fit algorithm(s) for the chosen scenario, and the cards re-order/highlight so the stronger fits are pulled to the front (a 'Primary' ribbon or fit label appears). Then click 'Clear' and verify the highlighting resets.

judgeValidationCriteria: The algorithm card gallery renders with multiple algorithm cards and problem-type tags
Selecting a scenario chip shows a recommendation banner and visibly re-ranks/highlights the cards; clearing resets it
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
